_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Social Interaction With One s Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصِيَّتِهِ لاِبنِهِ الحَسَنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: لا يَكُن أهلُكَ أشقَى الخَلقِ بِكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in his will to his son al-Hasan (AS), ‘Let your family not become the most miserable of people because of you.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Social Interaction With One s Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ المَرءَ يَحتاجُ في مَنزِلِهِ وعِيالِهِ إلى ثَلاثِ خِلالٍ يَتَكَلَّفُها وإن لَم يَكُن في طَبعِهِ ذلكَ: مُعاشَرَةٍ جَميلَةٍ ، وسَعَةٍ بتَقديرٍ ، وغَيرَةٍ بتَحَصُّنٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily man needs to adopt three characteristics with respect to his household and his family, even if these are not naturally present within him pleasant social interaction, the capacity to live with ampleness through evaluation, and possessiveness through protectiveness.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أحسِنْ مُصاحَبَةَ مَن صاحَبَكَ تَكُن مُسلِماً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Associate well with one who associates with you and you will be considered a Muslim.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خالِطوا النّاسَ بألسِنَتِكُم وأجسادِكُم ، وزايِلوهُم بِقُلوبِكُم وأعمالِكُم.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Interact with people with the use of your tongues and your bodies, and part from them with your hearts and your actions.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُبذُلْ لأِخيكَ دَمَكَ ومالَكَ ، ولِعَدُوِّكَ عَدلَكَ وإنصافَكَ ، ولِلعامَّةِ بِشرَكَ وإحسانَكَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘For your brother, offer your blood and your wealth, for your enemy your justice and fairness, and for people in general your joy and your good favour.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ألزِم نَفسَكَ التَّوَدُّدَ ، وصَبِّر على مُؤَناتِ النّاسِ نَفسَكَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Obligate yourself to adopt affection, and make yourself tolerate the encumbrances of people.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن أسرَعَ إلَى النّاسِ بما يَكرَهونَ قالوا فيهِ ما لا يَعلَمونَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who is quick to criticize people in a manner that they dislike, they will talk about him saying that which they do not know.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صاحِبِ النّاسَ مِثلَ ما تُحِبُّ أن يُصاحِبوكَ بِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Associate with people the way you would like them to associate with you.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُجامَلَةُ النّاسِ ثُلثُ العَقلِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Amicableness towards people is a third of intellect.

_source.chapter: What is Required When Interacting With People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): التَّوَدُّدُ إلَى النّاسِ نِصفُ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘Affection towards people is half of intellect.

_source.chapter: Sorrow
_source.arabic: عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن كَثُرَ هَمّهُ سَقُمَ بَدنُه.
_source.english: Prophet Jesus (AS) said, ‘He who has much anxiety, his body starts to ail.

_source.chapter: Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الهَمُّ نِصفُ الهَرَمِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Worry is half of old age.

_source.chapter: Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الهمُّ يُذيبُ الجَسَدَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Worry wastes away the body.

_source.chapter: Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الأحْزانُ أسْقامُ القُلوبِ، كما أنَّ الأمْراضَ أسْقامُ الأبْدانِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Sorrows are the ailments of the hearts just as illnesses are the ailments of the body.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : مَن نَظرَ إلى ما في أيْدي النّاسِ طالَ حُزنُهُ ، ودامَ أسَفُهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Whoever looks at what other people possess, his sorrow endures and his regret is continuous.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : رُبَّ شَهْوةِ ساعةٍ تُورِثُ حُزناً طويلاً .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Many a desire lasting but an hour brings about enduring sorrow.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن غَضِبَ على مَن لا يقدِرُ أنْ يَضُرَّهُ ، طالَ حُزْنُهُ وعَذّبَ نَفْسَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who is angry with somebody whom he cannot hurt, his sorrow endures and he inflicts pain on his own soul.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما رأيتُ ظالِما أشْبَهَ بمظلومٍ من الحاسِدِ؟ نَفَسٌ دائمٌ، وقَلبٌ هائمٌ، وحُزنٌ لازِمٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘I have not seen a wrong-doer resemble a wronged person more than the jealous one: he has an exhausted spirit, a wandering heart, and an inherent sorrow.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن قَصَّر في العملِ ابْتُلي بالهَمِّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who is negligent in his work is afflicted with anxiety.

_source.chapter: The Causes of Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إيّاكَ والجَزَعَ ؛ فإنَّهُ يَقْطَعُ الأملَ ، ويُضعِفُ العَملَ ، ويُورِثُ الهَمَّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Beware of apprehension, for it kills hope, weakens action, and brings about worry.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : إنّ اللّهَ ـ بحُكْمِهِ وفَضْلِه ـ جَعلَ الرَّوحَ والفَرحَ في اليقينِ والرِّضا ، وجَعلَ الهَمَّ والحُزنَ في الشَّكِّ والسُّخْطِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Truly Allah, out of His wisdom and grace, placed bliss and happiness in conviction and contentment, and placed worry and sorrow in doubt and discontentment.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : أيُّها النّاسُ ، هذهِ دارُ تَرَحٍ لا دارُ فَرَحٍ ، ودارُ الْتِواءٍ لا دارُ اسْتِواءٍ ، فمَن عَرَفها لَم يَفْرَحْ لِرَجاءٍ ، ولَم يَحْزَنْ لِشَقاءٍ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘O people! This is the house of pain and not the house of joy, and the house of writhing [in pain] not the house of repose. So he who knows it will neither rejoice for ease and nor will he grieve for misfortune.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : قَولُ : «لا حَولَ ولا قُوّةَ إلّا باللّهِ» فيهِ شِفاءٌ مِن تِسعَةٍ وتِسْعينَ داءً ، أدْناها الهَمُّ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘There is remedy in the statement “There is no might or power save in Allah” (La Hawla wa la quwwata illa billah) for ninety-nine ailments, the least of them being anxiety.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: عن ابنِ عبّاسٍ : ما انْتَفَعْتُ بكلامٍ بَعدَ رسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) كانْتِفاعي بكِتابٍ كَتَبَهُ عليُّ بنُ أبي طالبٍ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ، فإنَّهُ كَتبَ إلَيَّ : أمّا بَعدُ فإنَّ المَرءَ يَسوؤهُ فَوتُ ما لَم يَكُن لِيُدْرِكَهُ ، ويَسُرُّهُ دَرْكُ ما لَم يَكُن لِيَفوتَهُ ، فلْيَكُنْ سُرورُكَ بما نِلْتَ مِن آخِرَتِكَ ، ولْيَكُن أسَفُكُ على ما فاتَكَ مِنها ، وما نِلْتَ مِن دُنْياكَ فلا تَكُنْ بهِ فَرِحا ، وما فاتَكَ مِنها فلا تَأْسَ علَيهِ حُزْناً، ولْيَكُنْ هَمُّكَ فيما بَعدَ المَوتِ . والسَّلامُ .
_source.english: Ibn Abbas narrated, ‘I have not profited by any speech after the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) more than by a letter written by Ali b. Abi Talib (AS). He wrote to me, saying, “But now, indeed man grieves for having missed that which he would not have attained anyway, and is overjoyed at attaining that which he would not have missed anyway. So, let your happiness be for what you attain for your Hereafter, and let your regret be for what you miss of it. Do not be happy for what you attain for this world, nor regret sorrowfully what you miss from it, and let your concern be for what comes after death, and peace be with you.”

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : نِعْمَ طارِدُ الهُمومِ اليَقينُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘What an excellent repellent of worries conviction is.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : غَسْلُ الثِّيابِ يُذهِبُ الهَمَّ والحُزنَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Washing clothes takes away worry and sorrow.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنْ كانَ كُلُّ شيءٍ بقَضاءٍ وقَدَرٍ ، فالحُزْنُ لِماذا؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If everything is determined by fate and destiny, then wherefore the sorrow?!

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : شَكا نَبيٌّ مِن الأنبياءِ إلى اللّهِ الغَمَّ ، فأمَرهُ بأكْلِ العِنَبِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘One of the prophets complained of his grief to Allah. So he commanded him to eat grapes.

_source.chapter: That Which Exterminates Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَن وَجَدَ هَمّا ولا يَدري ما هُو فلْيَغْسِلْ رأسَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who finds himself sorrowful for no reason should wash his head.

_source.chapter: The Reason for Sorrow and Joy for an Unknown Cause
_source.arabic: عن أبي بصيرٍ : دَخَلتُ على أبي عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ومَعي رجُلٌ مِن أصْحابِنا ، فقُلتُ لَهُ : جُعِلتُ فِداكَ يابنَ رسولِ اللّهِ ، إنّي لَأغْتَمُّ وأحْزَنُ مِن غَيرِ أنْ أعْرِفَ لِذلكَ سَبباً، فقالَ أبو عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ ذلكَ الحُزنَ والفَرحَ يَصِلُ إلَيكُم مِنّا؛ لأنّا إذا دَخلَ علَينا حُزنٌ أو سُرورٌ كانَ ذلكَ داخِلاً علَيكُم ، لأنّا وإيّاكُم مِن نُورِ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ .
_source.english: Abu Basir narrated, ‘I once went to visit Abu Abdillah Al-Sadiq (AS) along with one of our companions. I said to him, ‘O son of the Prophet! Could I but sacrifice myself for you. I grieve and become sorrowful without knowing the cause of that. So Abu Abdillah (AS) replied, ‘Truly that sorrow and joy reaches you from us, for when sorrow or joy comes to us it comes to you too, for indeed we and you are all from the Light of Allah, Mighty and Exalted.'
_source.chapter_ar: عِلَّةُ الحُزنِ وَالفَرَحِ مِن غَيرِ سَبَبٍ يُعرَفُ

_source.chapter: The Reason for Sorrow and Joy for an Unknown Cause
_source.arabic: رُوي أنَّه سئلَ العالِمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) عنِ الرّجُلِ يُصْبِحُ مَغْموماً لا يَدْري سَببَ غَمِّهِ ، فقالَ : إذا أصابَهُ ذلكَ فلْيَعْلَمْ أنَّ أخاهُ مَغْمومٌ ، وكذلكَ إذا أصْبَحَ فَرْحانَ لغَيرِ سَببٍ يُوجِبُ الفَرَحَ ، فباللّهِ نَسْتَعينُ على حُقوقِ الإخْوانِ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that the scholar Al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked about why a man may wake up in the morning feeling sad without knowing the reason for his sorrow. He said, ‘If that happens to him then he should know that his brother is in sorrow, and similarly if he wakes up happy without a specific reason for that joy. And Allahs help do we seek with regard to the rights of the brothers.
_source.chapter_ar: عِلَّةُ الحُزنِ وَالفَرَحِ مِن غَيرِ سَبَبٍ يُعرَفُ

_source.chapter: Praiseworthy Sorrow
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) : ما عُبِدَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ على مِثْلِ طُولِ الحُزْنِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is worshipped through nothing like continuous sorrow.

_source.chapter: Praiseworthy Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ اللّهَ يُحِبُّ كُلَّ قَلبٍ حَزينٍ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Truly Allah loves every sorrowful heart.

_source.chapter: Praiseworthy Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَرَأتُ في كِتابِ عليٍّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ المؤمنَ يُمْسي حَزيناً ويُصبِحُ حَزيناً، ولا يَصْلُحُ لَهُ إلّا ذلكَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believer wakes up in the morning sorrowful and sleeps at night sorrowful, and nothing suits him but that.

_source.chapter: Praiseworthy Sorrow
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : نَفَسُ المَهْمومِ لَنا المُغْتَمِّ لظُلْمِنا تَسْبيحٌ ، وهَمُّهُ لأمْرِنا عِبادَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The breath of one who is saddened on our account and is grieved for the oppression done unto us is glorification, and his grief for our cause is worship.

_source.chapter: The Spirit
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ الأرواحَ لا تُمازِجُ البَدَنَ ولا تُواكِلُهُ ، وإنّما هِي كِلَلٌ لِلبَدَنِ مُحِيطَةٌ به.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily the spirits neither merge with the body nor are they independent of it. Rather they are like a thin veil surrounding the body.

_source.chapter: The Spirit
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الرُّوحُ جِسمٌ رَقِيقٌ قد اُلبِسَ قالَبا كثيفا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The spirit is a subtle form that envelopes a dense shell [i.e. the body].

_source.chapter: Spirits are Pre-Mobilized Groups
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الأرواحُ جُنودٌ مُجَنَّدَةٌ ، فما تَعارَفَ مِنها ائتَلَفَ ، وما تَناكَرَ مِنها اختَلَفَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Spirits are pre-mobilized groups [from their conception in the pre-material world, and by virtue of their nature (ed.)] in that they are mutually attracted to other spirits that they are in harmony with, and they mutually repel those that they clash with.

_source.chapter: Spirits are Pre-Mobilized Groups
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المَوَدَّةُ تَعاطُفُ القُلوبِ في ائتِلافِ الأرواحِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Love is when hearts harbour mutual affection due to the harmony between their spirits.

_source.chapter: Spirits are Pre-Mobilized Groups
_source.arabic: كنز العمّال عن شقيق بن سلمة: جاءَ رجُلٌ إلى عَلِيٍّ وكَلَّمَهُ ، فقالَ في عُرضِ الحديثِ: إنّي اُحِبُّكَ ، فقالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ: كَذَبتَ . قالَ: لِمَ يا أميرَ المؤمنينَ ؟ قالَ: لأنّي لا أرى قَلبِي يُحِبُّكَ ، قالَ النبيُّ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الأرواحَ كانَت تَلاقى في الهَواءِ فَتَشامُّ ، ما تَعارَفَ مِنها ائتَلَفَ ، وما تَناكَرَ مِنها اختَلَفَ . فلَمّا كانَ من أمرِ عَلِيٍّ ما كانَ ، كانَ مِمَّن خَرَجَ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Shaqiq b. Salama narrated that a man once came to Imam Ali (AS) and was talking to him. In the course of the conversation, he told Imam Ali (AS) that he loved him. Imam replied, 'That is not true. The man asked, 'Why, O Commander of the Faithful?' He replied, 'Because I do not find my heart loving you, and the Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily spirits meet each other in the air and sense each other, and those that are in harmony with each other are mutually attracted, and those that clash repel each other.

_source.chapter: The States of the Spirit
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ لِلجِسمِ سِتَّةَ أحوالٍ: الصِّحّةُ ، والمَرضُ ، والمَوتُ ، والحَياةُ ، والنَّومُ ، واليَقَظَةُ ، وكذلكَ الرُّوحُ ، فحياتُها عِلمُها ، ومَوتُها جَهلُها ، ومَرَضُها شَكُّها ، وصِحَّتُها يَقِينُها ، ونَومُها غَفلَتُها ، ويَقَظَتُها حِفظُها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The body experiences six different states: health, sickness, death, life, sleep and wakefulness, and so does the spirit. Its life is its knowledge and its death ignorance; its sickness is doubt whereas its health is certainty; its sleep is its negligence and its wakefulness is its consciousness.

_source.chapter: The Spirit During Sleep
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ عندما سَألَه أبو بصيرٍ عنِ الرُّوحِ عِندَ النَّومِ أخارِجٌ مِن البَدَنِ؟ ـ: لا يا أبا بصيرٍ ، فإنَّ الرُّوحَ إذا فارَقَتِ البَدَنَ لَم تَعُدْ إلَيهِ ، غَيرَ أنّها بمَنزِلَةِ عَينِ الشَّمسِ مَركُوزةٌ في السماءِ في كَبِدِها ، وشُعاعُها في الدنيا.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), when asked by his companion Abu Basir whether the spirit remains with the body during sleep or leaves it, replied, 'No, O Abu Basir, verily if the spirit were to leave the body it would never again return to it. It is actually like the sun that is fixed in its place in the centre of the sky, yet its rays extend out to the earth.

_source.chapter: The Spirit During Sleep
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ المَرءَ إذا نامَ فإنّ رُوحَ الحَيَوانِ باقِيَةٌ في البَدَنِ ، والذي يَخرُجُ مِنهُ رُوحُ العَقلِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, 'When man sleeps, the animal spirit within him remains with his body, and that which leaves it is the rational spirit.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Following Up Peoples Flaws
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيّاكُم والظَّنَّ، فإنَّ الظّنَّ أكْذَبُ الحَديثِ، ولا تَحَسَّسوا، ولا تَجَسَّسو.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Beware of suspicion, for verily suspicion is the greatest lie; and do not probe one another [for information] nor spy on one another.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Following Up Peoples Flaws
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّي لَم اُؤمَرْ أنْ اُنقِّبَ عن قُلوبِ النّاسِ ولا أشُقَّ بطُونَهُم.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I have not been ordered to pry open the hearts of people nor to cleave their bellies [for information or flaws].

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Following Up Peoples Flaws
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَطلُبوا عَثَراتِ المؤمنينَ ؛ فإنّ مَن تَتَبّعَ عَثَراتِ أخيهِ تَتَبّعَ اللّهُ عَثَراتِهِ، ومَن تَتَبّعَ اللّهُ عَثَراتِهِ يَفْضَحْهُ ولو في جَوفِ بَيتِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Do not probe for flaws in believers, for a man that probes the flaws of his brother will have Allah probe his own flaws; and when Allah probes the flaws of a man, He will expose him even if he were inside his own home.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Following Up Peoples Flaws
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَسألوا الفاجِرَةَ: مَن فَجَرَ بِكِ ؟ فكما هانَ علَيها الفُجورُ، يَهونُ علَيها أنْ تَرميَ البَريءَ المسلِمَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Do not ask the woman who fornicates about her partner in the offense; for just like it was easy for her to commit fornication, so it will be easy for her to accuse an innocent Muslim.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Following Up Peoples Flaws
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تُفَتِّشِ النّاسَ عن أديانِهِم فتَبقى بلا صَديقٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Do not probe into the religiosity of people lest you remain without a friend.

_source.chapter: Permissibility of Spying In War
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) إذا بَعثَ جيشاً فاتَّهَم أميراً، بَعثَ مَعهُ مِن ثِقاتِهِ مَن يتَجَسَّسُ لَه خَبرَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘When the Prophet (SAWA) would send an army with a commander that he did not fully trust, he used to send someone whom he trusted to report on the commanders conduct.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئل عنِ القاضي أيَحِلُّ لَه أن يَقضيَ بقَولِ البَيِّنَةِ إذا لَم يعرِفهُم مِن غَير مسألَةٍ ـ: خَمسَةُ أشياءَ يَجِبُ على النّاسِ أنْ يأخُذوا بِها ظاهِرَ الحُكْمِ: الوِلاياتُ، والتّناكُحُ، والمَوارِيثُ، والذَّبائحُ، والشّهاداتُ، فإذا كانَ ظاهرُهُ ظاهرا مأموناً جازَتْ شهادتُهُ، ولا يُسألُ عن باطنِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Five things must be judged with the benefit of the doubt: allegiance, marriage, inheritance, animal slaughtering, and testimonies. If the person appears to be trustworthy, his testimony must be accepted without investigating his inner thoughts.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ سَمْحاً ولا تَكُنْ مُبَذِّراً ، وكُنْ مُقَدِّراً ولا تَكُنْ مُقَتِّراً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Be liberal, but do not squander; and be calculating, but do not be parsimonious.
_source.cited_from: Sharhe Nahj al-Balagha li Ibn Abi al-Hadid, volume:18, p. 150

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التَّبذيرُ عُنوانُ الفاقةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Squandering is the epitome of destitution.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التّبذيرُ قَرِينٌ مُفْلِسٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Squandering is a penniless companion.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ افْتَخَر بالتَّبذيرِ احتُقِرَ بالإفْلاسِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who takes pride in squandering will be humiliated by bankruptcy.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قولهِ تعالى : «ولا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيراً» ـ : مَن أنْفقَ شيئاً في غيرِ طاعةِ اللّهِ فهُو مُبَذّرٌ ، ومَن أنْفقَ في سبيلِ الخيرِ فهُو مُقْتَصِدٌ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said about the verse: “but do not squander wastefully” ‘[It refers to one who spends for other than the obedience of Allah, who is a squanderer; and one who spends in the path of good, who is economical.

_source.chapter: What Must Be Given The Benefit Of The Doubt
_source.arabic: عن أبي بصيرٍ : سألتُ أبا عبدِ اللّهِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) في ـ قولِه : «ولا تُبذّر تَبذيراً» ، قالَ : بَذْلُ الرّجُل مالَهُ ويَقعُدُ ليسَ لَهُ مالٌ ، قالَ : فيَكونُ تَبذيرٌ في حلالٍ ؟ قالَ : نَعَم.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, in answer to Abu Basirs question about the verse: “but do not squander wastefully” ‘When a man spends all his money and remains penniless. Abu Basir then asked, ‘Is spending in such a way for something lawful still called squandering? He replied, ‘Yes.

_source.chapter: The State [i.e. Governance] of Noble People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يُستدَلُّ على إدبارِ الدُّوَلِ بأربَعٍ: تَضييعِ الاُصولِ ، والتمسُّكِ بالفروعِ ، وتَقديمِ الأراذلِ ، وتأخيرِ الأفاضِلِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The fall of states can be discerned by four things: neglect of the fundamentals, embracing peripheral matters, bringing contemptible ones to the forefront and relegating the virtuous ones.

_source.chapter: The State [i.e. Governance] of Noble People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وأعظَمُ ما افتَرَضَ سبحانَهُ مِن تِلكَ الحُقوقِ حَقُّ الوالِي على الرَّعِيَّةِ ، وحقُّ الرعيّةِ على الوالِي ... فإذا أدَّتِ الرعيّةُ إلى الوالي حقَّهُ وأدَّى الوالِي إلَيها حَقَّها عَزَّ الحَقُّ بينهم ، وقامَت مناهِجُ الدِّينِ ، واعتَدَلَتْ مَعالِمُ العَدلِ ، وجَرَت على أذلالِها السُّنَنُ ، فَصَلَحَ بذلك الزمانُ ، وطُمِعَ في بَقاءِ الدَّولةِ ، ويَئسَت مطامِعُ الأعداءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The greatest of the rights that the Glorified [Allah] has made obligatory on man is the right of the ruler over the ruled and the right of the ruled over the ruler…so if the ruled fulfil the rights of the ruler and the ruler fulfils their rights, then the truth attains the position of honour among them, the ways of religion become established, the marks of justice affirmed, the prophetic practice gets implemented correctly, current times improve, the continuance of the state is desired and the ambitions of the enemies are thwarted.

_source.chapter: The State [i.e. Governance] of Noble People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما حُصِّنَ الدُّوَلُ بمِثلِ العَدلِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Nothing fortifies states like justice.

_source.chapter: The State [i.e. Governance] of Noble People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): صَيِّرِ الدِّينَ حِصنَ دَولَتِكَ ، والشُّكرَ حِرزَ نِعمَتِكَ ، فَكُلُّ دَولَةٍ يَحوطُها الدِّينُ لا تُغلَبُ ، وكلُّ نِعمَةٍ يَحرُزُها الشُّكرُ لا تُسلَبُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Make religion the fortress of your state, and thankfulness a protection for your bounties, because every state whose fortress is religion is invincible and every bounty encompassed by thankfulness remains.

_source.chapter: The State [i.e. Governance] of Noble People
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مِن أماراتِ الدَّولةِ اليَقَظَةُ لِحراسَةِ الاُمورِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘One of the signs of a [stable] government is vigilance in safeguarding matters.

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا سَهَرَ إلّا في ثلاثٍ: مُتَهَجِّدٍ بالقرآنِ ، وفي طَلَبِ العِلمِ ، أو عَروسٍ تُهدى إلى زَوجِها.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'There is no need to stay awake at night except in three instances: when staying awake to recite the Qur'an, to gain knowledge, and for a bride to be offered to her husband.

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا سَهَرَ بعدَ العِشاءِ الآخِرَةِ إلّا لأِحَدِ رَجُلَينِ: مُصَلٍّ أو مُسافِرٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'There is no need to stay up at night past the last Aisha prayer except in the case of two people: the person performing prayers, and the traveller.

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): السَّهَرُ رَوضَةُ المُشتاقِينَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Staying awake at night is the garden of those who yearn [for Allah].

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): سَهَرُ الليلِ في طاعَةِ اللّهِ رَبيعُ الأولياءِ ورَوضَةُ السُّعَداءِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Staying awake at night engaged in acts of obedience to Allah is the springtime of the friends of Allah and the garden of the good-fortuned.

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ سَهَرُ العُيونِ بذِكرِ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'The best of worship is for the eyes to remain awake engaged in the remembrance of Allah, Glory be to Him.

_source.chapter: Staying Awake at Night
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): فاتَّقُوا اللّهَ عِبادَ اللّهِ تَقِيَّةَ ذِي لُبٍّ ، شَغَلَ التَّفَكُّرُ قَلبَهُ ، وأنصَبَ الخَوفُ بَدَنَهُ ، وأسهَرَ التَّهَجُّدُ غِرارَ نَومِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'So be conscious of your duty to Allah, O servants of Allah, with the caution of a wise man whose heart is preoccupied with reflection [about the Hereafter], whose body the fear [of Allah] has afflicted with pain, and whose engagement in the night prayer has turned his already short sleep into wakefulness.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remaining Awake on Specific Nights
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أحيا لَيلةَ العِيدِ ولَيلةَ النِّصفِ مِن شَعبانَ ، لَم يَمُتْ قَلبُهُ يَومَ تَموتُ القُلوبُ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who remains awake on the eve of Aid al-fitr and on the eve of the 15th of Shaaban, his heart will not die on the Day when hearts shall die.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Remaining Awake on Specific Nights
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ أميرُ المؤمنينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) لا يَنامُ ثلاثَ ليالٍ: لَيلةَ ثلاثٍ وعِشرِينَ مِن شَهرِ رَمَضانَ ، ولَيلةَ الفِطرِ ، ولَيلةَ النِّصفِ مِن شَعبانَ ، وفيها تُقسَمُ الأرزاقُ والآجالُ وما يَكونُ في السَّنَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) narrated, 'The Commander of the Faithful (AS) did not used to sleep at all on three nights: the 23rd night of the month of Ramazan, the eve of Aid al-fitr, and the eve of the 15th of Shaaban. And these are the nights when sustenance is allotted, and prescribed times of death and all that is to happen in that year is decreed.

_source.chapter: Factors that Cause One to Stray (from the Straight Path)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِكُلِّ ضَلَّةٍ عِلَّةٌ، ولِكُلِّ ناكِثٍ شُبهَةٌ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘For every misguidance there is a cause, and behind every disloyal act is an obscurity.

_source.chapter: Factors that Cause One to Stray (from the Straight Path)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ألاَ وإنّ شَرائعَ الدِّينِ واحِدَةٌ، وسُبُلَهُ قاصِدَةٌ، مَن أخَذَ بها لَحِقَ وغَنِمَ، ومَن وَقَفَ عَنها ضَلَّ ونَدِمَ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Know that indeed the paths to religion are one, and its courses lead straight ahead. Whoever follows them attains the objective, and whoever stops, moving away from them, strays and ends up regretful.

_source.chapter: Factors that Cause One to Stray (from the Straight Path)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُنظُرُوا أهلَ بَيتِ نَبِيِّكُم فَالْزَمُوا سَمْتَهُم ... لا تَسبِقُوهُم فَتَضِلُّوا، ولا تَتَأخَّرُوا عَنهُم فَتَهلِكُوا .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Look at the household of your Prophet and adhere to their direction…Do not overtake them, for then you will stray, nor lag behind them lest you fall into ruin.

_source.chapter: Factors that Cause One to Stray (from the Straight Path)
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن يَطلُبِ الهِدايَةَ مِن غَيرِ أهلِها يَضِلَّ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who seeks guidance from the wrong source goes astray.

_source.chapter: Those Who Lead Others Astray
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ شَرَّ الناسِ عندَ اللّهِ إمامٌ جائرٌ ضَلَّ وضُلَّ بهِ، فَأماتَ سُنَّةً مأخوذَةً (مَعلومَةً)، وأحيا بِدعَةً مَتروكَةً.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the most evil of people in the sight of Allah is the tyrannical leader who himself has gone astray and through whom others go astray. He abolishes established practices and revives abandoned innovations.

_source.chapter: Those Who Lead Others Astray
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ أبغَضَ الخَلائقِ إلى اللّهِ رَجُلانِ: رَجُلٌ وَكَلَهُ اللّهُ إلى نَفسِهِ، فهُو جائرٌ عَن قَصدِ السَّبيلِ، مَشغوفٌ بكَلامِ بِدعَةٍ ودُعاءِ ضَلالَةٍ، فهُو فِتنَةٌ لِمَنِ افتُتِنَ بهِ، ضالٌّ عن هَديِ مَن كانَ قَبلَهُ، مُضِلٌّ لِمَنِ اقتَدى بهِ في حَياتِهِ وبعدَ وَفاتِهِ، حَمّالُ خَطايا غَيرِهِ، رَهنٌ (رَهِينٌ) بخَطيئَتهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the most detested of all people in the sight of Allah are two: the man whom Allah has relegated to his own carnal self, so he has deviated from the straight path and is passionately fond of talking about innovations and misguiding others towards the wrong path. He tempts those who are charmed by him. He himself has strayed away from the guidance of his predecessors, and misleads those who follow him during his life as well as after his death. He carries the burden of others sins and is entangled in his own misdeeds…

_source.chapter: Those Who Lead Others Astray
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في صِفةِ المنافقينَ ـ: اُحَذِّرُكُم أهلَ النِّفاقِ ؛ فإنّهُمُ الضالُّونَ المُضِلُّونَ، والزّالُّونَ المُزِلُّونَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in his description of the hypocrites, ‘I warn you against the hypocrites, for verily they are themselves misguided and they misguide other people. They have slipped and they cause others to slip too.

_source.chapter: That Which Destroys the Pillars of Misguidance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): استَعِينُوا بهِ [أي بالقرآنِ] على لأَْوائكُم؛ فإنَّ فيهِ شِفاءً مِن أكبَرِ الداءِ، وهُو الكُفرُ والنِّفاقُ، والغَيُّ والضَّلالُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Seek its assistance [i.e. the Qurans] in your distress, for verily it contains the cure for the deadliest diseases, namely disbelief and hypocrisy, revolt and misguidance.

_source.chapter: That Which Destroys the Pillars of Misguidance
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ هذا الإسلامَ دِينُ اللّهِ الذي اصطَفاهُ لنفسِهِ ... وهَدَمَ أركانَ الضَّلالةِ بِرُكنِهِ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Indeed this Islam is the religion of Allah which he has chosen for Himself … and has smashed the pillars of misguidance with its one pillar.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: أوحَى اللّهُ تعالى إلى داوودَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تُرِيدُ واُرِيدُ، وإنّما يَكونُ ما اُرِيدُ ، فإن سَلَّمتَ لِما اُريدُ كَفَيتُكَ ما تُرِيدُ ، وإن لَم تُسَلِّم لِما اُرِيدُ أتعَبتُكَ فيما تُرِيدُ ، ثُمّ لا يَكونُ إلّا ما اُرِيدُ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that Allah, most High, revealed to Prophet David (AS) saying, 'I want [something] and you want [something else], and verily only My will is done. Therefore, if you submit to what I want, I will suffice you in what you want. If you do not submit to My will, however, I will exhaust you in your quest for what you want, until only what I want will be.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحَقُّ مَن خَلَقَ اللّهُ بِالتَّسليمِ لِما قَضَى اللّهُ ، مَن عَرَفَ اللّهَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Out of all that Allah has created, the worthiest person of submission to Allah's decree is he who knows Allah.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّا لَنُحِبُّ أن نُعافى فِيمَن نُحِبُّ ، فإذا جاءَ أمرُ اللّهِ سَلَّمنا فيما يُحِبُّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Indeed we desire for ourselves and those we love to be blessed with well-being, but when Allah's command comes, we submit to what He loves.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ: بِأيِّ شَيء عُلِمُ المؤمنُ أنّهُ مُؤمِنٌ ؟ ـ: بِالتَّسليمِ للّهِ ، والرِّضا بما وَرَدَ علَيهِ مِن سُرورٍ وسَخَطٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was once asked how a believer may ascertain that he is indeed a believer, to which he replied, 'Through submission to Allah and satisfaction with whatever source of happiness or discontent that comes his way.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لَم يَكُن رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يقولُ لِشيءٍ قد مَضى: لو كانَ غَيرَهُ !
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'The Prophet (SAWA) never used to utter the words 'if only...' with regards to anything that had already passed.

_source.chapter: Submission
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا قالَ العبدُ: ما شاءَ اللّهُ لاحَولَ ولا قُوَّةَ إلّا بِاللّهِ ، قالَ اللّهُ: مَلائكَتي اِستَسلَمَ عَبدي أعِينُوهُ ، أدرِكُوهُ ، اُقضُوا حاجَتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'When a servant says, 'Whatever Allah wills, there is no power and no strength except in Allah', Allah says, 'O My angels, My servant has submitted so assist him, hasten to him and grant his request.

_source.chapter: Suckling
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ليسَ للصَّبيِّ لَبَنٌ خَيرٌ مِن لَبَنِ اُمِّهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'There is no better milk for a child than the milk of his mother.
_source.cited_from: Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), volume:2, p. 34, number:69

_source.chapter: Suckling
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُنظُرُوا مَن تُرضِعُ أولادَكُم؛ فإنّ الوَلَدَ يَشِبُّ علَيهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Take into account who it is that suckles your children, for verily this is what a child grows on.

_source.chapter: Suckling
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِستَرضِعْ لِولدِكَ بِلَبَنِ الحِسانِ ، وإيّاكَ والقِباحَ ؛ فإنّ اللَّبَنَ قد يُعدِي.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'Get beautiful wet-nurses to suckle your child and keep away from ugly ones, for verily the milk has an effect [on the child].

_source.chapter: Types of Wet-Nurses That Should Not Be Employed
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَستَرضِعُوا الحَمقاءَ ، ولا العَمشاءَ؛ فإنّ اللَّبَنَ يُعدِي .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not employ wet-nurses that are stupid or bleary-eyed for verily the milk has an effect [on the child].

_source.chapter: Types of Wet-Nurses That Should Not Be Employed
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): تَوَقَّوا على أولادِكُم لَبَنَ البَغِيِّ مِن النِّساءِ ، والمَجنونَةِ ؛ فإنّ اللَّبَنَ يُعدِي .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Protect your children from the milk of prostitutes and madwomen, for verily the milk has an effect [on the child].

_source.chapter: Types of Wet-Nurses That Should Not Be Employed
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): رِضاعُ اليَهوديّةِ والنَّصرانيّةِ خَيرٌ مِن رِضاعِ الناصِبيّةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Getting a Christian or a Jewish wet-nurse to suckle a child is better than a Nasibiyya.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدُّعاءُ مُخُّ العِبادَةِ ، ولا يَهلِكُ مَعَ الدُّعاءِ أحَدٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Supplication is the essence of worship and no one who supplicates will be destroyed.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الدُّعاءُ سِلاحُ المُؤمِنِ وَعَمودُ الدّينِ وَنورُ السَّماواتِ والأرضِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Supplication is the weapon of the believer, the pillar of religion, and the light of the heavens and the earth.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ أعجَزَ النّاسِ مَن عَجَزَ عَنِ الدُّعاءِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily the weakest person is the one who is incapable of supplicating.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أفضَلُ العِبادَةِ الدُّعاءُ ، فإذا أذِنَ اللّهُ لِلعَبدِ في الدُّعاءِ فَتَحَ لَهُ بابَ الرَّحمَةِ ، إنّهُ لَن يَهلِكَ مَعَ الدُّعاءِ أحَدٌ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best worship is supplication, for when Allah gives permission [and divine succour] for His servant to supplicate, He opens for him the door of mercy. Surely the one who supplicates will never be destroyed.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وَصِيَّتِهِ لاِبنِهِ الحَسَنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: اِعلَمْ أنَّ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ خَزائنُ مَلَكُوتِ الدُّنيا وَالآخِرَةِ قَد أذِنَ لِدُعائكَ ، وتَكَفَّلَ لِإجابَتِكَ ، وَأمَرَكَ أن تَسألَهُ لِيُعطِيَكَ ، وَهُوَ رَحيمٌ كَريمٌ ، لَم يَجعَلْ بَينَكَ وَبَينَهُ مَن يَحجُبُكَ عَنهُ ، وَلَم يُلْجِئْكَ إلى مَن يَشفَعُ لَكَ إلَيهِ ... ثُمَّ جَعَلَ في يَدِكَ مَفاتيحَ خَزائنِهِ بِما أذِنَ فيهِ مِن مَسألَتِهِ ، فَمَتى شِئتَ استَفتَحتَ بِالدُّعاءِ أبوابَ خَزائنِهِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said in his counsel to his son Hasan (AS), ‘Know that the one in whose hands are the treasures the kingdom of this world and the Hereafter has allowed you to supplicate, He has guaranteed to answer you, He has commanded you to ask Him so He can give you, and He is the All-Merciful, the Kind. He has not placed any barrier between Him and you, He has not committed you to whoever intercedes for you… then He has placed in your hands the keys to His treasures by allowing you to ask from Him, so whenever you wish, open the doors of His treasures by supplicating to Him.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ مِفتاحُ الرَّحمَةِ وَمِصباحُ الظُّلمَةِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Supplication is the key to mercy and a lantern in the darkness.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أحَبُّ الأعمالِ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ فِي الأرضِ الدُّعاءُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘The most beloved action on this earth with Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is supplication.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ تُرْسُ المُؤمِنِ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Supplication is the shield of the believer.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكَ بِالدُّعاءِ ، فإنَّ فيهِ شِفاءً مِن كُلِّ داءٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘I urge you to supplicate, for verily in supplication is a cure for every ailment.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: عن ميسّر بن عبد العزيز عن أبي عبد اللّه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قال لي: يا ميسّر اُدعُ ولا تَقُلْ: إنَّ الأمرَ قَد فُرِغَ مِنهُ ، إنَّ عِندَ اللّهِ عزّوجلّ مَنزِلَةً لا تُنالُ إلّا بِمَسألَةٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Supplicate and do not say, “the matter has already been decreed”, for verily there is a station with Allah that can only be attained through supplication.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ أنفَذُ مِنَ السِّنانِ الحَديدِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Supplication is more useful than a sharp iron spearhead.

_source.chapter: Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامِ الرِّضا (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكُم بِسِلاحِ الأنبِياءِ . فَقيلَ: وما سِلاحُ الأنبِياءِ؟ قالَ: الدُّعاءُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Rida (AS) said, ‘I urge you to use the weapon of the prophets, upon which he was asked, ‘What is the weapon of the prophets?, to which he replied, ‘Supplication.

_source.chapter: Supplication Wards Off Inescapable Fate
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يَرُدُّ القَضاءَ إلّا الدُّعاءُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Nothing wards off fate except supplication.
_source.cited_from: Makarim al- Akhlaq, volume:2, p. 7, number:1978

_source.chapter: Supplication Wards Off Inescapable Fate
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الدُّعاءُ يَدفَعُ البَلاءَ النّازِلَ وَما لَم يَنزِلْ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘Supplication repels descended calamities and those which are yet to descend.

_source.chapter: Supplication Wards Off Inescapable Fate
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): عَلَيكُم بِالدُّعاءِ ، فَإنَّ الدُّعاءَ للّهِ ، وَالطَّلَبَ إلى اللّهِ يَرُدُّ البَلاءَ وَقَد قُدِّرَ وَقُضِيَ وَلَم يَبقَ إلّا إمضاؤهُ ، فإِذا دُعِيَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ وسُئلَ صَرْفَ البَلاءِ صَرَفَهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘I urge you to supplicate, for verily supplication to Allah and seeking from Allah repels calamity which may have been destined and decreed with just the execution remaining, so if Allah is supplicated and is asked to avert a calamity, it is averted.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِدفَعوا أبوابَ البَلاءِ بِالدُّعاءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Repel the doors of calamity with supplication.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِدفَعُوا أمواجَ البَلاءِ بِالدُّعاءِ ، ما المُبتَلَى الَّذي استَدَرَّ بِهِ البَلاءُ بِأحوَجَ إلَى الدُّعاءِ مِنَ المُعافَى الَّذي لا يَأمَنُ البَلاءَ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Repel the surges of calamity with supplication. The person who is continuously facing calamities is not more in need of supplication than that person who is free and secure from calamity.

_source.chapter: Supplication Repels Various Types of Calamity
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَخَوَّفَ بَلاءً يُصيبُهُ فَتَقَدَّمَ فيهِ بِالدُّعاءِ لَم يُرِهِ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ ذلكَ البَلاءَ أبَداً.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The one who fears the onset of a calamity and precedes it with supplication, Allah will never afflict him with that calamity.

_source.chapter: Priority with Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أوْحَى اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى إلى داوود (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُذكُرْني في سَرَّائكَ أستَجِبْ لَكَ في ضَرَّائكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that Allah revealed to Prophet David (AS), ‘Remember me in the good days so that I may answer [and assist] you in the bad [and difficult] days.

_source.chapter: Priority with Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): تَعَرَّفْ إلَى اللّهِ فِي الرَّخاءِ يَعرِفْكَ فِي الشِّدَّةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Acquaint yourself with Allah in times of ease and Allah will acknowledge you in times of difficulty.

_source.chapter: Priority with Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَنبَغي للمُؤمِنِ أن يَكونَ دُعاؤهُ فِي الرَّخاءِ نَحْواً مِن دُعائهِ فِي الشِّدَّةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘A believer must supplicate Allah in times of ease the same way that he supplicates Allah in times of difficulty.

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: فيما أوحَى اللّهُ إلى موسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا موسى ، سَلْني كلَّ ما تَحتاجُ إلَيهِ ، حتّى عَلَفَ شاتِكَ ، ومِلحَ عَجينِكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that Allah revealed to Prophet Moses (AS), ‘O Moses, ask Me for every single thing that you need, even the grass for your sheep to graze and the salt for your food.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سَلُوا اللّهَ عزّوجلّ ما بدا لَكُم مِن حوائجِكُم حتّى شِسعَ النَّعلِ؛ فإنّهُ إنْ لَم يُيَسِّرْهُ لَم يَتَيسَّرْ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Ask Allah for whatever occurs to you from your needs even for the laces of your shoes, for verily if He does not facilitate for it, it will not be facilitated.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Enjoinment of Supplication for Every Need
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تُحَقِّرُوا صَغيراً مِن حَوائجِكُم ؛ فإنّ أحَبَّ المؤمنينَ إلَى اللّهِ تَعالى أسألُهُم.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Do not deem the smallest of your needs as insignificant, for verily the most beloved of the believers with Allah is the one who asks [Him] the most.
_source.chapter_ar: الحَثُّ عَلَى الدُّعاءِ في كُلِّ حاجَةٍ

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا أرادَ اللّهُ أن يَستَجِيبَ لعبدٍ أذِنَ لَهُ في الدُّعاءِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When Allah wants to answer or respond to His servant, He allows him [through divine succour] to supplicate.

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَرَعَ بابَ اللّهِ سبحانَهُ فُتِحَ لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘He who knocks on Allahs door, it is opened for him.

_source.chapter: Supplication is the Key to Granting [of a Request]
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما فَتَحَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ على أحدٍ بابَ مسألةٍ فَخَزنَ عَنهُ بابَ الإجابةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Allah has never opened the door of request for anyone only to hold back the door of response.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ و قَد سَألَهُ قومٌ: نَدعو فلا يُستَجابُ لَنا ؟! ـ: لأنَّكُم تَدعونَ مَن لا تَعرِفونَهُ.
_source.english: A group of people asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS), ‘We supplicate but are not answered? the Imam said, ‘Because you call upon One whom you do not know.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في قَولِهِ: «فَلْيَستَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي» ـ: يَعلَمُونَ أنِّي أقدِرُ عَلَى أنْ اُعطِيَهُم ما يَسألُونِّي .
_source.english: Regarding the saying of Allah, “so let them respond to Me, and let them have faith in Me” Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘It means that: “they should know that I [Allah] am capable of giving them what they ask Me for”.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Inner Knowledge
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ لَمّا سُئلَ عن قولِ اللّهِ تَعالى: «أُدْعُونِي أسْتَجِبْ لَكُم» فما بالُنا نَدعو فلا نُجابُ؟ ـ: لأنَّ قُلوبَكُم خانَتْ بِثَماني خصالٍ: أوّلُها أنَّكُم عَرَفتُمُ اللّهَ فلَم تُؤَدُّوا حَقَّهُ كما أوجَبَ علَيكُم، فما أغنَتْ عنكُم مَعرِفَتُكُم شَيئا ... فأيُّ دُعاءٍ يُستَجابُ لَكُم مَع هذا وقد سَدَدْتُم أبوابَهُ وطُرُقَهُ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) when he was asked regarding Allahs verse: “Call Me and I will hear you[r supplications]” ‘So why does it happen that we supplicate and are not answered? - replied, ‘Because your hearts have been treacherous in eight areas, the first of them being that you know Allah but you do not fulfil your right towards Him as is obligatory upon you, so your inner knowledge of Him has not benefited you at all… so then which supplication will be answered for you with this [state of affairs after you have blocked its doors and paths?!

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ العبدَ لَيَرفَعُ يَدَهُ إلى اللّهِ ومَطعَمُهُ حَرامٌ، فكيفَ يُستَجابُ لَهُ وهذا حالُهُ ؟!
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily a servant raises his hands to Allah [in supplication] while his food is unlawful! So how can his supplications be answered while he is in this state?!

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أطِبْ كَسبَكَ تُستَجَبْ دَعوَتُكَ ، فإنَّ الرّجلَ يَرفَعُ اللُّقْمَةَ إلى فِيهِ (حَراماً) فما تُستَجابُ له دَعوَةٌ أربَعينَ يوماً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Make your earnings lawful and your supplication will be answered, for verily when a man raises an unlawful morsel of food to his mouth, his supplication is not answered for forty days.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Lawful Earning
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا أرَادَ أحدُكُم أن يُستَجابَ لَهُ فَليُطَيِّبْ كَسبَهُ ولْيَخرُجْ مِن مَظالِمِ الناسِ ، و إنَّ اللّهَ لا يُرفَعُ إلَيهِ دُعاءُ عبدٍ وفي بَطنِهِ حرامٌ أو عندَهُ مَظلِمَةٌ لِأحَدٍ مِن خَلقِهِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If any of you wants his supplication to be answered then he should make a lawful earning and stop wronging people, for verily the supplication of a servant who has unlawful food in his stomach or has wronged anyone from Allahs creation will not be raised to Allah.

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اِعلَموا أنّ اللّهَ لا يَستجيبُ دُعاءً مِن قلبٍ غافِلٍ لاهٍ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Know that Allah does not answer supplication from a heedless and distracted heart.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اغتَنِموا الدُّعاءَ عند الرِّقَّةِ فإنَّها رحمةٌ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Seize the opportunity to supplicate during tenderness [of your heart] for verily it is a mercy.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ لا يَستَجِيبُ دُعاءً بظَهرِ قلبٍ قاسٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah does not answer the supplication that comes from a hard heart.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Conditions for the Answering of Supplication: Presence of the Heart and its Tenderness During Supplication
_source.arabic: عنه (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا رَقَّ أحدُكُم فَليَدعُ ، فإنَّ القلبَ لا يَرِقُّ حَتّى يَخلُصَ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When any of you feels softness and compassion, then he should supplicate, for no sooner does the heart soften than it becomes pure and sincere.
_source.chapter_ar: شُروطُ استِجابَةِ الدُّعاءِ ـ حضورُ القلبِ ورقّتُهُ عِندَ الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Sins
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ العبدَ يسألُ اللّهَ الحاجةَ فيكونُ من شَأنِهِ قضاؤها إلى أجلٍ قريبٍ أو إلى وقتٍ بَطيءٍ ، فيُذنِبُ العبدُ ذنباً فيقولُ اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وَتَعالى للمَلَكِ: لا تَقضِ حاجَتَهُ واحرِمْهُ إيَّاها ، فإنَّهُ تَعَرَّضَ لِسَخَطي واستَوجَبَ الحِرمانَ مِنّي.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Verily a servant asks Allah his need and it is Allahs way that He either grants it very soon or after some time. The servant sins and Allah, Blessed and most High, says to the angels, ‘Do not grant him, and deprive him of it for verily he has exposed himself to My displeasure and has made himself deserving of My deprivation.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Oppression
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ أوحى إلى عيسَى بنِ مَريَمَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قُلْ لِلمَلاِء مِن بَني إسرائيلَ ... إنّي غَيرُ مُستَجِيبٍ لِأحَدٍ مِنكُم دَعوَةً ولِأحَدٍ من خَلْقي قِبَلَهُ مَظلِمَةٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Allah revealed to Prophet Jesus (AS) saying, ‘Tell the community of Israelites that… verily I do not answer the supplication of anyone from among you against whom one of My creation holds a claim of wrong or oppression.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Oppression
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ يَقولُ: وَعِزَّتي وَجَلالي ، لا اُجِيبُ دَعوَةَ مَظلومٍ دَعاني في مَظلِمَةٍ ظُلِمَها ولأحدٍ عندَهُ مثلُ تِلك المَظلِمَةِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Verily Allah says, ‘By My Might and Exaltedness, I do not answer the supplication of one who has been wronged when he calls Me regarding the wrong that has been done unto him, while someone else holds a similar claim of wrong against him.

_source.chapter: Factors that Prevent the Answering of Supplication: Opposing Wisdom
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ كَرَمَ اللّهِ سُبحانَهُ لا يَنقُضُ حِكمَتَهُ ، فَلِذلِكَ لا يَقَعُ الإجابَةُ في كُلِّ دَعوَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Verily the Kindness of Allah, glory be to Him, does not contradict His Wisdom, therefore not all supplications are answered.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: The Basmala
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا يُرَدُّ دُعاءٌ أوَّلُهُ بِسمِ اللّهِ الرّحمنِ الرَّحيمِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The supplication that is preceded by “In the Name of Allah, the all-Beneficent, the all-Merciful” will not be rejected.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Praise
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ كُلَّ دُعاءٍ لا يَكونُ قَبلَهُ تَمجيدٌ فَهُوَ أبتَرُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily every supplication that is not preceded by praise [of Allah] is incomplete.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Blessings upon Prophet Muhammad (SAWA) and his Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَزالُ الدُّعاءُ مَحجوباً حَتّى يُصَلّى عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A supplication remains veiled until the supplicant sends blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِه

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Blessings upon Prophet Muhammad (SAWA) and his Family
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن كانَت لَهُ حاجَةٌ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ فَلْيَبدَأ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِهِ ، ثُمَّ يَسألْ حاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ يَختِمْ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، فإنَّ اللّهَ عزّوجلّ أكرَمُ مِن أن يَقبَلَ الطَّرَفَينِ ويَدَعَ الوَسَطَ إذ كانَتِ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ لا تُحجَبُ عَنهُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘If anyone has a need from Allah, then he should begin by sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family, then ask his need. Thereafter he should seal it by sending blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, for verily Allah is too kind than to just accept the two blessings [at the beginning and at the end] and leave the middle, because the request for blessings on Muhammad and his family is never veiled from Him.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الصَّلاةُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِه

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Seeking Intercession of the Righteous
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الكاظمُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا كانَت لَكَ حاجَةٌ إلى اللّهِ فَقُل: اللّهُمَّ إنّي أسألُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وعَلِيٍّ ، فَإنّ لَهُما عِندَكَ شَأناً مِنَ الشَّأنِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Kazim (AS) said, ‘If you have a need from Allah, then say, “O Allah, verily I ask you for the sake of Muhammad and Ali, for verily they have a special station with You.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Acknowledgement of Sins
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّما هِيَ المِدحَةُ ، ثُمَّ الإقرارُ بِالذَّنبِ ، ثُمَّ المَسألَةُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘[In supplication] praise Allah, then acknowledge your sins, then ask your request.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Imploring and Begging
_source.arabic: فيما وَعَظَ اللّهُ بِهِ عيسى (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا عيسى، اُدعُني دُعاءَ الحَزينِ الغَريقِ الّذي لَيسَ لَهُ مُغِيثٌ ... ولا تَدْعُني إلّا مُتَضَرِّعاً إلَيَّ وهَمُّكَ هَمّاً واحِداً، فَإنَّكَ مَتى تَدْعُني كَذلِكَ أجَبتُكَ.
_source.english: It is narrated in Bihar al-Anwar that among Allahs exhortations to Prophet Jesus (AS) was, ‘O Jesus, call upon Me with a supplication of a sorrowful one, as if he is drowning and has no saviour…and only supplicate Me by imploring Me, with the supplication being your prime concern, for verily if you call Me like that, I will answer you.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Imploring and Begging
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسينُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): كانَ رَسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) يَرفَعُ يَدَيهِ إذا ابتَهَلَ ودَعا كَما يَستَطعِمُ المِسكينُ.
_source.english: Imam al-Husayn (AS) said, ‘The Prophet (SAWA) used to raise his hands and implore and beg [to Allah] just like the poor man begs for food.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Performing Two Units of Prayer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن تَوَضَّأ فَأحسَنَ الوُضوءَ ، ثُمَّ صَلّى رَكعَتَينِ، فَأتَمَّ رُكوعَهُما وَسُجودَهُما ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ، وأثنى عَلَى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ وعَلى رَسولِ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ، ثُمَّ سَألَ حاجَتَهُ ، فَقَد طَلَبَ في مَظانِّهِ ، وَمَن طَلَبَ الخَيرَ في مَظانِّهِ لَم يَخِبْ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Whoever performs the ablution correctly and thereafter prays two units of prayer, completes its genuflexions and prostrations, sends the salutations [at the end of the prayer], praises Allah and the Prophet (SAWA), then asks his need in the right place will not be disappointed, because whoever seeks good from the right place is never disappointed.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أن يُصَلِّيَ رَكعَتَينِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Not to Regard Ones Own Request as Too Much
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا تَستَكثِرُوا شَيئاً ممّا تَطلُبُونَ، فما عِندَ اللّهِ أكثَرُ مِمّا تُقدِّرونَ.
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘Do not regard anything that you seek from Allah as too much, for verily what is with Allah is much greater than you could comprehend.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ لا يَستَكثِرَ مَطلوبَهُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Have a High Ambition for What You Seek
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ في وصيَّتِهِ إلى ابنِهِ الحسنِ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) ـ: ولتَكُن مَسألَتُكَ فيما يَعنِيكَ مِمّا يَبقى لَكَ جَمالُهُ ويُنفى عنكَ وبالُهُ ، والمالُ لا يَبقى لك ولا تَبقى لَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) in his counsel to his son al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘Your request [from Allah] must be for such as will aid you of the things whose beauty and goodness will remain for you and whose evil consequences will not touch you, and wealth will neither remain for you, and nor will you remain for it.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ يكونَ عالي الهِمَّةِ فيما يَطلُبُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Have a High Ambition for What You Seek
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ عليه السلام في سُؤالِ عجوزِ بني إسرائيلَ لموسى عليه السلام: قالت: لا أفعَلُ حتّى تُعْطِيَني خِصالاً: تُطلِقُ رِجْلي ، وتُعِيدَ إلَيَّ بَصَري ، وتَرُدَّ إلَيَّ شَبابِي ، وتَجعَلَني معكَ في الجَنّةِ
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrated, ‘An old woman from among the Israelites asked Moses (AS) a question; she said, ‘I will not do what you wish until you give me a few things: you cause my leg to work, give me back my sight, return to me my youth and make me be with you in Paradise.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ أنْ يكونَ عالي الهِمَّةِ فيما يَطلُبُ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: To Supplicate for Everyone
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إذا دَعا أحَدٌ فَلْيُعِمَّ فإنّه أوجَبُ للدُّعاءِ ، ومَن قَدَّمَ أربعينَ رَجُلاً مِن إخوانِهِ قَبلَ أن يَدعُوَ لِنفسِهِ استُجِيبَ لَهُ فيهِم وفي نفسِهِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘When someone supplicates, he should pray for everyone, for it renders his supplication more conducive to being answered, and whoever precedes forty from among his brothers in supplication before supplicating for himself, his supplication for them as well as himself will duly be answered.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Supplicating in Secrecy
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): دَعوةٌ في السِّرِّ تَعدِلُ سبعينَ دَعوةً في العَلاَنِيَةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘A supplication asked in secret equals seventy supplications asked openly.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Supplication in Congregation
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ما اجتَمَعَ أربعةُ رَهطٍ قَطُّ على أمرٍ واحدٍ فَدَعَوا اللّهَ إلّا تَفَرَّقُوا عن إجابَةٍ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘No sooner do four people congregate to supplicate together for one matter than they depart with an answer.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ الاجتماعُ في الدُّعاءِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Being Optimistic about the Answer
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): اُدْعُوا اللّهَ وأنتُم مُوقِنونَ بالإجابَةِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Supplicate to Allah being convinced that he will answer you.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ حُسنُ الظَّنِّ بِالإِجابَة

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Being Optimistic about the Answer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا دَعَوْتَ فَظُنَّ أنّ حاجَتَكَ بالبابِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When you supplicate, be optimistic that your request has reached the door [of Allah].
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ حُسنُ الظَّنِّ بِالإِجابَة

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Selecting a Suitable Time
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): خيرُ وقتٍ دَعَوتُم اللّهَ عزّوجلّ فيهِ الأسحارُ ، وتلا هذهِ الآيةَ في قولِ يعقوبَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): «سَوْفَ أسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي» و قال: أخَّرَهُم إلى السَّحَرِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The best time to supplicate to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, is the time before dawn, then he recited the verse which is the saying of Prophet Jacob (AS), “I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you”, then he said, ‘He postponed [supplicating for them] till the time before dawn.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ اختيارُ الأوقاتِ المناسِبَةِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Selecting a Suitable Time
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): ثلاثةُ أوقاتٍ لا يُحجَبُ فيها الدُّعاءُ عن اللّهِ: في أثَرِ المكتوبةِ ، وعند نُزُولِ القَطْرِ ، وظُهورِ آيةٍ معجزةٍ للّهِ في أرضِهِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are three times when supplication is not veiled from Allah at all: after completion of an obligatory act, during rainfall, and during the manifestation of a miraculous sign from Allah on the earth.
_source.chapter_ar: آدابُ الدُّعاءِ ـ اختيارُ الأوقاتِ المناسِبَةِ

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Insistence
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): رَحِمَ اللّهُ عبدا طَلَبَ مِن اللّهِ عزّوجلّ حاجةً فَألَحَّ في الدُّعاءِ ، اُستُجِيبَ لَهُ أو لم يُستَجَبْ لَهُ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah has mercy on a servant who seeks a need from Him and insists in supplication, whether it is answered or unanswered for him.

_source.chapter: The Etiquette of Supplication: Insistence
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): واللّهِ لا يُلِحُّ عبدٌ مُؤمِنٌ علَى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ في حاجتِهِ إلّا قضاها لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, ‘By Allah, no sooner does a believing servant insist to Allah, Mighty and Exalted, regarding a need than He fulfils it for him.

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: Supplication for the Impossible and the Impermissible
_source.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا صاحِبَ الدُّعاءِ ، لا تَسأل عَمّا لا يَكونُ ولا يَحِلُّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘O supplicant, do not ask for the impossible and the impermissible.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ الدُّعاءُ لِما لا يَكونُ ولا يَحِلُّ

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: To Seek a Hasty Response
_source.arabic: ـ الكافي عن أبي بصير عن الإمام الصّادق (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَزالُ المُؤمِنُ بِخَيرٍ ورَجاءٍ رَحمَةً مِنَ اللّهِ ما لَم يَستَعجِلْ فَيَقنَطُ وَيَترُكُ الدُّعاءَ . قُلتُ لَهُ: كَيفَ يَستَعجِلُ؟ قالَ: يَقولُ: قَد دَعَوتُ مُنذُ كَذا وكَذا وما أرَى الإجابَةَ!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believer continues to remain in goodness, comfort, and mercy from Allah as long as he does not seek a hasty response, then despair and abandon supplication as a consequence. The Imam was asked, ‘How does he hasten?, to which he (AS) replied, ‘He says, ‘I have supplicated since such and such a time and I do not yet see an answer.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ الاِستِعجالُ

_source.chapter: What the Supplicant Must Not Do: Do Not Instruct Allah about What is Good for You
_source.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): قالَ اللّهُ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى: يابنَ آدَمَ ، أطِعْني فيما أمَرتُكَ ، ولا تُعَلِّمْني ما يُصلِحُكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Blessed and most High, has said, ‘O son of Adam, obey Me in what I have commanded, and do not instruct Me about what is good for you.
_source.chapter_ar: ما يَنبَغي عَلَى الدَّاعي تَركُهُ ـ أنْ لا يُعَلِّمَ اللّهَ ما يُصلِحُهُ

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: عن أبي حمزة: إنَّ اللّهَ أوحَى إلى داوود (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يا داوود ، إنّه لَيسَ عبدٌ مِن عبادِي يُطِيعُني فيما آمُرُهُ إلّا أعطَيتُهُ قَبلَ أن يَسألَني ، وأستَجِيبُ له قَبلَ أن يَدعُوَني.
_source.english: AbU Hamza narrated, ‘Verily Allah revealed to Prophet David (AS), ‘O David, verily no sooner does a servant from among My servants obey Me in what I have commanded him than I give him before he asks Me, and I answer him before he supplicates Me.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يقولُ اللّهُ: مَن شَغَلَهُ ذِكري عن مَسألَتي أعطَيتُهُ فوقَ ما اُعْطِي السائلينَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Allah, Mighty and Exalted, says, ‘The one who is too preoccupied with My remembrance to ask Me, I give him more than what the ones who ask have been given.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Request is Granted without Asking
_source.arabic: فاطمةُ الزَّهراءُ (عَلَيهَا الّسَلامُ): مَن أصعَدَ إلى اللّهِ خالصَ عبادَتِهِ أهبَطَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ له أفضَلَ مَصلَحَتِهِ .
_source.english: Fatima al-Zahra (AS) said, ‘The one who sends up to Allah his pure and sincere worship, Allah, Mighty and Exalted, sends down for him that which will be of most benefit to him.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Supplication is Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أنا الضَّامِنُ لِمَن لَم يَهجُسْ في قلبِهِ إلّا الرّضا أن يَدعُوَ اللّهَ فَيُستَجابَ لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘I guarantee that the one who does not harbour anything but contentment in his heart will be answered when he supplicates to Allah.

_source.chapter: The One Whose Supplication is Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن لم يَرجُ النّاسَ في شيءٍ ورَدَّ أمرَهُ إلى اللّهِ عزّوجلّ في جميعِ اُمورِهِ استَجابَ اللّهُ عزّوجلّ لَهُ في كلِّ شيءٍ .
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘He who does not place his hope in people for anything and refers all his matters instead to Allah, Allah - Mighty and Exalted - will grant his every need.

_source.chapter: The Supplications that are Answered
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إيَّاكُم ودَعوَةَ الوالِدِ ، فإنَّها أحَدُّ مِن السَّيفِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Beware of the supplication of the parent, for verily it is sharper than a sword.

_source.chapter: The Supplications that are Answered
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): دعاءُ أطفالِ اُمَّتي مُستَجابٌ ما لَم يُقارِفوا الذُّنوبَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The supplications of the children of my community are answered as long as they have not fallen into sins.

_source.chapter: The Supplications that are Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الحسنُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن قَرَأ القرآنَ كانَت لَهُ دعوةٌ مُجابةٌ إمّا مُعَجَّلَةً و إمّا مُؤَجَّلةً.
_source.english: Imam al-Hasan (AS) said, ‘The one who recites the Quran has a supplication of his answered, be it immediately or later.

_source.chapter: Supplications that are Not Answered
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): سألتُ اللّهَ أن لا يَستَجيبَ دعاءَ حبيبٍ على حبيبِهِ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘I asked Allah not to answer the supplication of an enamoured one against his beloved.

_source.chapter: Supplications that are Not Answered
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): أربعٌ لا يُستَجابُ لَهُم دعاءٌ: الرجلُ جالسٌ في بَيتِهِ يقولُ: يا ربِّ ارزُقْني ، فيقولُ لَهُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بالطَّلَبِ ؟ ! ورجلٌ كانَت لَهُ امرأةٌ فَدَعا علَيها ، فيقولُ: ألَم أجعَلْ أمرَها بيدِكَ ؟! ورجلٌ كانَ لَهُ مالٌ فأفسَدَهُ فيقولُ: يا ربِّ ارزُقْني ، فيقولُ لَهُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بالاقتِصادِ؟! ... ورجلٌ كانَ لَهُ مالٌ فأدانَهُ بغيرِ بَيِّنَةٍ فَيَقولُ: ألَم آمُرْكَ بِالشَّهادَةِ؟!
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘There are four kinds of people whose supplications do not get answered: the man who sits in his house saying, ‘O my Lord, grant me sustenance, to whom He says, ‘Did I not command you to seek [for your sustenance]?, then there is the man who has a wife and supplicates against her, to whom He replies, ‘Did I not make you responsible for her?, and a man who has wealth and wastes it, who says, ‘O my Lord, grant me sustenance, to whom He replies, ‘Did I not command you to be economical?…and a man who has wealth and loans it to someone without keeping any proof [of loan], to whom He replies, ‘Did I not command you to take a witness?!

_source.chapter: The Reason for a Delayed Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يُقَنِّطَنَّكَ إبطاءُ إجابتِهِ ، فإنَّ العطيَّةَ على قَدْرِ النِّيَّةِ ، وربّما اُخِّرَتْ عنكَ الإجابةُ لِيَكونَ ذلكَ أعظَمَ لِأجرِ السائلِ وأجزَلَ لِعَطاءِ الآمِلِ ، وربّما سألتَ الشيءَ فلم تُؤْتاهُ واُوتيتَ خيراً مِنهُ عاجِلاً أو آجِلاً ، أو صُرِفَ عنكَ لِما هُوَ خيرٌ لكَ ، فَلَرُبَّ أمرٍ قد طَلِبْتَهُ وفيهِ هلاكُ دينِكَ لو اُوتيتَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A delay in response should not dishearten you, for verily the grant [from Allah] is proportional to [the sincerity of] your intention, and maybe the response has been delayed in order for it to be a greater reward for the one who asked and a greater bestowal for the hopeful one, or maybe you asked for something and it was not given to you and instead you are to be granted something better sooner or later, or it may have been kept away from you for your own good, for many a matter that you ask for would be detrimental to your religion [and faith] if it were to be given to you.

_source.chapter: The Reason for a Delayed Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): قالَ اللّهُ تعالى: وعِزَّتي وجلالي وعَظَمَتي وبَهائي ، إنّي لَأحمِي وَليّي أن اُعطِيَهُ في دارِ الدنيا شيئاً يشغَلُهُ عن ذِكري حتّى يَدعُوَني فأسمَعَ صوتَهُ ، و إنّي لَاُعطي الكافرَ مُنيَتَهُ حتّى لا يَدعُوَني فَأسمَعَ صوتَهُ بُغضاً لَهُ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘Allah said, ‘By My Might, Exaltedness, Greatness and Splendour, verily I protect My friend by not giving him something in this world that will preoccupy him from My remembrance, and so [that he may continue to call Me] so that I can hear his voice, and verily I grant the disbeliever his wish for him so that he stops calling Me lest I hear his voice.

_source.chapter: The Reasons for a Lack of Response
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ عليه السلام: جاءَ رجلٌ إلى أميرِ المؤمنينَ عليه السلام فقال: إنّي دَعَوتُ اللّهَ فلَم أرَ الإجابةَ ! فقالَ: لقد وَصَفتَ اللّهَ بغيرِ صِفاتِهِ ، و إنَّ للدُّعاءِ أربعَ خصالٍ: إخلاصُ السَّريرةِ ، و إحضارُ النِّيّةِ ، ومَعرفةُ الوسيلةِ ، والإنصافُ في المسألةِ ، فهل دَعَوتَ وأنتَ عارفٌ بهذهِ الأربعةِ ؟ قالَ: لا ، قالَ: فاعرِفْهُنَّ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘A man came to the Commander of the Faithful and said, ‘Verily I have supplicated to Allah, but I have not received an answer!, the Imam (AS) said, ‘You have described Allah in a manner that He is not worthy of being described, for verily supplication has four stages: sincerity of the heart, making the intention, having true knowledge of the means, and being fair regarding the request. So did you supplicate knowing these four conditions? He said, ‘No, then the Imam (AS) said, ‘Then know them now.

_source.chapter: Supplication is not Without Effect
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنَّ رَبَّكم حَيِيٌّ كريمٌ ، يَستَحيِي أن يَبسُطَ العبدُ يَدَيهِ إلَيهِ فَيَرُدَّهُما صِفراً.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘Verily your Lord is bashful and kind. He would be too ashamed for His servant to open his hands to Him [in supplication] and for Him to return them empty.

_source.chapter: Supplication is not Without Effect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ زينُ العابدينَ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): المؤمنُ مِن دُعائهِ على ثلاثٍ: إمّا أن يُدَّخَرَ لَهُ ، و إمّا أن يُعَجَّلَ لَهُ ، و إمّا أن يُدْفَعَ عَنهُ بَلاءٌ يُريدُ أن يُصِيبَهُ.
_source.english: Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) said, ‘There are three types of outcome from a believers supplication: either it is stored away for him for later, or it is hastened for him, or it repels a calamity waiting to afflict him.

_source.chapter: Supplication is not Without Effect
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): يَتَمَنّى المؤمنُ أنّه لم يُستَجَبْ لَهُ دَعوَةٌ في الدنيا مِمّا يَرى مِن حُسنِ الثوابِ.
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘The believer would wish that none of his supplications were answered in this world when he sees his beautiful and great rewards [in the Hereafter].

_source.chapter: Suspicion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إذا اتَّهَمَ المؤمنُ أخاهُ انْماثَ الإيمانُ مِن قلبِهِ كما يَنْماثُ المِلحُ في الماءِ .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘When a believer suspects his fellow brother, his faith disappears from his heart like salt disappears in water.

_source.chapter: Suspicion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اتَّهمَ أخاهُ في دِينِهِ فلا حُرمَةَ بَينَهُما .
_source.english: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, ‘He who suspects the religion of his brother removes the covenant between them.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللّه (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أولى النّاسِ بالتُّهْمةِ مَن جالَسَ أهلَ التُّهْمةِ .
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, ‘The person most deserving of suspicion is he who sits with suspect people.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إيّاكَ ومَواطِنَ التُّهْمةِ والمجلسَ المَظْنونَ بهِ السّوءُ ، فإنَّ قَرينَ السُّوءِ يَغُرُّ جَلِيسَهُ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘Stay away from places of suspicion and suspect gatherings, for an evil friend seduces his companion.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَن وَقَفَ نَفسَهُ مَوقِفَ التُّهْمةِ فلا يلُومَنَّ مَن أساءَ بهِ الظّنَّ .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who places himself in a suspect situation must not blame those who suspect him.

_source.chapter: Prohibition of Placing Oneself In Suspect Circumstances
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): من دَخلَ مَداخِلَ السُّوءِ اتُّهِم .
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, ‘A man who enters suspect places will be suspected.

_source.chapter: The All-Sustainer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَملِكُ إمساكَ الأرزاقِ وإدرارَها إلّا الرَّزَّاقُ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'No one has the power to withhold or bestow sustenance except the All-Sustainer.

_source.chapter: The All-Sustainer
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وقَدَّرَ الأرزاقَ فَكَثَّرَها وقَلَّلَها ، وقَسَّمَها على الضِّيقِ والسَّعَةِ ، فَعَدَلَ فيها لِيَبتَلِيَ مَن أرادَ ، بِمَيسورِها ومَعسورِها ، ولِيَختَبِرَ بذلكَ الشُّكرَ والصَّبرَ مِن غَنِيِّها وفَقيرِها.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He apportions sustenance, abundantly and sparingly, and He distributes them to those in need as well as to those who prosper, and He is Just in His allotment in order that he may test whomever He wishes with prosperity or with hardship, and that He may test therewith the gratefulness and perseverance expressed by both rich and poor.

_source.chapter: Sustenance is Guaranteed
_source.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَتَشاغَلْ عمّا فُرِضَ علَيكَ بِما قد ضُمِنَ لَكَ فإنّهُ لَيسَ بفائتِكَ ما قد قُسِّمَ لَكَ ، ولَستَ بِلاحِقٍ ما قد زُوِيَ عنكَ.
_source.english: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not preoccupy yourself away from the duties incumbent upon you in your bid to secure that which is guaranteed to you, for indeed neither will you miss out on that which has been apportioned for you, nor will you attain that which has been placed beyond your reach.

_source.chapter: Sustenance is Guaranteed
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِكُلِّ ذِي رَمَقٍ قُوتٌ.
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Every living thing has been given its own provision.
